articles.title: Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight
articles.summary:
GreenLight has started letting a PyTorch AI reviewer approve pull requests from its own maintainers. It is an open-source take on RADAR, the system Meta uses to land low-risk code changes without waiting on a human. The move comes as Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic and Sonar all describe ways to automate approval itself.
RADAR stands for Risk Aware Diff Auto Review. Meta described it in a paper published in May. The paper starts from a capacity problem. Significant lines of code per human-landed diff rose 105.9% year over year, and diffs per developer per month rose 51%.
Meta attributes more than 80% of that increase to agentic AI assistance. Review has not kept pace, and the share of diffs reviewed within 24 hours is dropping. The authors describe their response in narrow terms.
Rather than attempting to replace code review broadly, RADAR targets automation to diffs that satisfy conservative safety criteria.
RADAR sorts each diff by author and source before anything else. Deterministic codemods can be approved through a blanket policy and skip per-diff AI review. AI-generated codemods and automated runbooks go through a pipeline of safety checks, a Diff Risk Score and an LLM reviewer. Any failure sends the diff to a human.
RADAR pipeline for AI and bot diffs. Source: Meta, "Automating Low-Risk Code Review at Meta" (arXiv 2605.30208)

articles.title: develoPPP Ventures opens call for SA startups, offering $110k in matching funding
articles.summary:
develoPPP Ventures has opened applications for its latest South African cohort, which will see selected startups receive EUR100,000 (US$110,000) in non-dilutive funding.
develoPPP Ventures has backed 178 businesses across Africa, including 11 investments in South Africa. The current call is also open in Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Egypt and Nigeria.
The 12th cohort is run by DEG Impulse, a subsidiary of German development finance institution DEG, with VC4A and Jozi Angels as partners. It is funded by Germany’s Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ).
South African startups with proof of concept and early revenues, that can demonstrate a path to operational break-even within three years, and have secured, or are in advanced talks for, funding, are invited to apply.
The funding uses a 1:1 matching model, so startups must raise at least the same amount from other qualifying sources, including private investors. Jozi Angels will connect founders with angel and venture investors to help them meet that requirement.
“Through the develoPPP Ventures programme, we equip growth-stage entrepreneurs in South Africa with catalytic matching capital and bespoke technical support,” said Tasneem Natha, chief operating officer of Jozi Angels.
Applications close on December 31 and can be submitted here.

articles.title: Un essaim de drones qui attaque Ariane 6 ? Le Centre spatial guyanais « n’est pas du tout paré », mais ne voit pas l’urgence de passer aux lasers
articles.summary:
C’est une annonce qui illustre l’évolution rapide de la menace qui pèse sur les bases de lancement. Fin septembre 2026, l’US Space Force a annoncé qu’elle allait installer des lasers anti-drones à Cap Canaveral, la base de Floride d’où décollent les fusées de SpaceX et d’United Launch Alliance, après une intrusion à 2,5 kilomètres du pas de tir lunaire.
Très vite s’est posée une question évidente : qu’en est-il de la protection du Centre spatial guyanais (CSG), près de Kourou, qui constitue le principal spatioport européen ? À ce stade, personne ne prévoit de faire pareil, quand bien même le site est absolument stratégique pour lancer les fusées Ariane 6 et Vega-C.
Thierry Vallée, sous-directeur chargé de la protection, de la sauvegarde et de l’environnement au CSG, la base gérée par l’agence spatiale française, a été clair quand Numerama l’a interrogé sur place : « Pour le moment, on n’est pas du tout sur ce registre de neutralisation. » Le centre mise plutôt sur des brouilleurs et sur une très grande zone interdite de survol.
Ce choix s’explique d’abord par la géographie. Selon Thierry Vallée, le relatif isolement du Centre spatial guyanais (littéralement entre l’océan Atlantique et la jungle amazonienne) lui simplifie la tâche. La règlementation aussi : « La lutte anti-drone ici, elle est simplifiée par le fait qu’on est dans une zone qui naturellement est interdite de survol. »

Most materials simply react when something pushes, pulls, or bends them. But a very different category of matter can draw on its own energy to change shape and respond to outside forces in surprising ways. Known as active matter, these unusual materials are attracting growing scientific interest. Now, physicists from the universities of Amsterdam, New South Wales, and Cambridge have uncovered remarkable new behaviors that could change how future machines and robots are designed.
Everyday materials such as metal, concrete, glass, and rubber are generally considered passive. They can stretch, bend, shift, or change shape when forces act on them, but the energy needed to produce those changes comes from outside the material.

articles.title: Character.AI wants to sell chat histories from more than 21 million accounts in bankruptcy, and 42 states object
articles.summary:
Editor's take: Private conversations that millions of people had with AI characters are up for auction, and 42 state attorneys general want the sale stopped. Character.AI, now in Chapter 11, is trying to sell the saved chat histories of more than 21 million US accounts, 2.1 million of them registered to minors, to a buyer who would owe those users nothing.
Character.AI built its product on persistent, role-playing conversations. Users talk with characters for weeks or months, and the company stores every exchange on its servers. That archive is now one of the few valuable things left in the bankrupt company, and the attorneys general say the plan offers "no safeguards for the people whose conversations are being sold."
The technical value of such a trove is easy to see. Long, emotionally candid dialogue is the kind of material used to train chatbots to sound more human and keep users engaged. The same material is also sensitive in a way ordinary web data is not. Chats with a companion bot can include confessions, relationship details, and discussions of self-harm. Linked to an account, they are hard to anonymize.
Character.AI filed for bankruptcy in October after years of scandals and lawsuits. These included legal challenges over teen suicides and a claim from Disney over characters that used its intellectual property. Disney later bought some of the company's assets and hired chief executive Karandeep Anand. A similarly broad coalition of attorneys general opposed that deal…

articles.summary:
Friday, November 27th 2026
AMD's RDNA 5 Set for Linux Kernel 7.5 Support
AMD's RDNA 5 is nearing full software support from the open-source Linux kernel maintainers, as the project prepares to officially include this support in Linux kernel version 7.5. In early November, we reported that AMD released a series of patches to add GFX13 support to the open-source AMDGPU driver. Now, we learn that AMD's software and firmware engineers plan to merge GFX13 support, also known as RDNA 5, for the upcoming Linux 7.5 kernel, bringing the launch one step closer to reality. While software enablement typically occurs months before the actual hardware launch, this development is a promising sign that RDNA 5 is approaching its release, currently rumored for the second half of 2027.
In the past, there have been interesting mentions of two specific targets, GFX 13.0.1 and GFX 13.0.4, indicating that AMD is preparing at least two graphics IP configurations. These version numbers do not correspond to any specific GPU models, so it remains unclear which products they relate to. RDNA 5 is expected to be a significant advancement over RDNA 4, requiring numerous patches to add support. Today's pull request also includes mentions of the already-covered Display Core Next 6 (DCN6) display engine, which will be exclusive to RDNA 5. articles.title: Supercoin’s plan to bypass the dollar in African payments

Supercoin, the digital payments company owned by Betway parent Super Group, plans to use a Kenyan shilling-backed stablecoin to settle payments between South Africa and Kenya without routing them through the US dollar.
The company said it has applied to the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) for a stablecoin issuance licence and plans to start serving payment companies in the first half of 2027, subject to approval.
Supercoin wants a remittance firm to take in rand in South Africa, exchange the company’s rand-backed token, ZARsc, for its proposed Kenyan shilling token, KESsc, and pay out in Kenya. A direct swap would remove the need to buy and sell dollars.
The commercial test is whether Supercoin can trade enough rand and shillings to give payment companies a better rate and deliver the money as quickly as their existing providers.
“If we can provide enough liquidity to the ZAR-KES pair in our stablecoin, then we can start selling that rail for instant payments between South Africa and Kenya,” Gideon Greaves, Supercoin’s managing director, told TechCabal in an interview.
Kenya gave Supercoin a clear route to a licence and a market where payment firms were already familiar with stablecoins, Greaves said. Supercoin plans to start with remittance companies, fintechs, and payment networks, with work on a Kenyan consumer wallet expected in the second half of 2027.

The pCloud Pass password manager suffered a cyberattack, with users reporting that unknown devices had connected to their accounts even with two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled.
The incident was first reported by numerous pCloud customers who began receiving email notifications informing them that a new device had connected to their pCloud Pass accounts.
In two Reddit threads, customers worldwide reported receiving notifications warning that an unfamiliar device named "pd" connected to their account from the IP address 45.131.244.7 in Luxembourg, which users say belongs to pCloud's own infrastructure.
Several customers reported receiving the alerts despite having two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled on their accounts. However, when customers checked their accounts for connected devices, some found no unfamiliar devices listed.
Other pCloud customers reported receiving the same notifications despite never having used the company's password manager, including one who said the notification was sent to an email address associated with a pCloud storage account they had requested be deleted almost a year ago.
In response to the reports, pCloud confirmed its password manager had suffered a cyberattack, which the company says was quickly contained.
"A cyberattack targeting pCloud Pass occurred, which was promptly contained by the pCloud team," reads pCloud's statement.

Nigerian payments infrastructure company Payaza has acquired Seesail Technologies, the Ghana-founded commerce platform for small businesses.
Payaza offers payment collection, payout and merchant tools to businesses in Africa and international markets. It handles card, mobile money and bank payments in more than 40 currencies and operates in more than 27 countries.
Disrupt Africa reported recently Payaza had been authorised by the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) to provide payment gateway services, just weeks after getting regulatory approval in Zambia.

articles.title: Huawei says it can build better memory chips than Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, but the proof is still to come

Forward-looking: Tech giant Huawei will reportedly present a white paper on its in-house HBM chip design that some industry insiders speculate could outperform existing products from market leaders Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron. The presentation will be made at the International Solid-State Circuits Conference in San Francisco on February 16, 2027.
Huawei's novel HBM design reportedly supports twice the data-pin density of the current products from the three leading players. According to Bloomberg, the new interface uses 4,096 data pins split across 64 channels - twice the width of the 2,048-bit interface of existing HBM products from Samsung and Hynix.
To pack twice as many connections into the same physical footprint, Huawei is reportedly using five-layer wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding to fuse memory controllers directly onto stacked DRAM dies. In theory, the new architecture could deliver higher memory bandwidth and better efficiency, allowing more data to be transferred to the processor at the same time while consuming less power.
If the theoretical improvements translate into real-world gains, Huawei's HBM chips could be better suited for model training, AI inference, data ingestion, and other complex tasks than competing products. However, five-layer wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding could be difficult to scale, especially without access to advanced lithography, so it remains to be seen how Huawei will overcome the challenge.

Previously, organizations had two options for workforce access to AWS accounts: direct IAM role federation or IAM Identity Center. IAM role federation provides flexibility through custom trust policies, tags, and paths, but requires configuring identity providers and managing access independently in each account. IAM Identity Center provides centralized federation and provisioning through permission sets, but can be restrictive when teams need account-specific roles or permissions. Moumita Saha, senior security identity specialist solutions architect at AWS, Blake Franzen, senior security solutions architect at AWS, and Omar Zoma, principal security solutions architect at AWS, write:
Account access manager removes the trade-offs. It’s built for customers who want the single federation point and identity-propagation benefits of IAM Identity Center together with the flexibility of IAM roles.
Source: AWS blog

articles.title: Google va dévoiler les coordonnées personnelles des développeurs d’applications au monde entier

Google vient de dévoiler sa nouvelle politique en matière d’identification pour les développeurs d’applications mobiles. La firme de Mountain View a ainsi déclaré que tous les développeurs disposant d’un compte Play Console actif devront indiquer s’ils agissent en tant que commerçant ou non avant le 1er février 2027. Concrètement, Google considère comme commerçant toute personne physique ou morale qui agit dans le cadre d’une activité commerciale ou professionnelle.
Et Google ne fait pas dans la dentelle, car tous les développeurs d’applications sont concernés. Qu’ils proposent des applis payantes, des applis intégrant des achats intégrés, ou des applications financées par des revenus publicitaires dans leur application, ils devront se plier à ces nouvelles règles.
À noter que seuls les développeurs qui ne distribuent pas leurs applications dans l’Espace économique européen ou au Royaume-Uni pourront se déclarer comme étant non commerçants.

Its first home is the GP2 SSD, rated for more than 18 million random reads per second.
The Kioxia Corporation showcased a prototype of its new XL-Flash Generation 3 technology, next-generation low-latency, high-performance flash memory, at its KIOXIA Forum in Tokyo. The flash, which uses CMOS directly Bonded to Array, or CBA, for better power efficiency and storage density, is about 135% more efficient with 70% higher bit density than Gen 2, and its 3 µs average read latency is less than 10% of that of Kioxia’s standard BiCS8 TLC. Samples are due March 2027, and Kioxia named its GP2 enterprise SSDs, rated for more than 18 million 512-byte random read IOPS, as its first product using it.
The low-latency XL-Flash fills “a new memory tier” to bridge the gap between DRAM and regular flash memory, in a way that can complement or replace some DRAM to help drive down costs, especially in AI servers and data centers. This has some similarities to Optane, which used 3D XPoint instead, as a storage class memory (SCM) option to reach higher IOPS. Intel and Micron’s 3D XPoint stored bits as changes in the cell material’s resistance rather than as trapped charge like NAND, and Intel exited the Optane business in 2022. The XL-Flash NAND is built on BiCS flash technology, but it’s tuned for low read latency and high write endurance.

Just getting the game onto a hacked console was the hard part. Retail copies of GTA VI need PS5 system software 14.23, while the most recent public jailbreak stops at firmware 13.60. But a decrypted copy that surfaced online on November 25 was modified to run on consoles with firmware as old as 11.60.
Within hours, a Reddit user going by a_Criminai posted a frame rate patch for it on the PS5 jailbreak subreddit. The modder says it only helps on a 120Hz display, where it also cuts input latency considerably.
More importantly, it doesn't seem to break the game. GTA VI's speed appears to be tied to its 30 FPS cap. That became obvious last week, when a Quick Resume bug on the Xbox Series X lifted the limit. Some scenes jumped to 60 FPS, but Jason's animations also ran at double speed or faster.
The PS5 patch reportedly corrects the game's timing, so animations and physics behave normally at higher frame rates. Still, the modder admits this isn't true 60 FPS, since the patch simply removes the cap.

articles.title: Google Wallet fait un petit changement qui facilite encore plus le paiement par carte bancaire
articles.summary:
Google veut vraiment que vous utilisiez Google Wallet pour tous vos paiements sur Android. La meilleure solution pour ce faire est de rendre les paiements en ligne les plus simples possibles. Et Google a trouvé une nouvelle astuce : remplir automatiquement le cryptogramme de sécurité de votre carte bancaire.
Google Wallet peut remplir le CVV/CVC
Le CVV, ou CVC, est un petit code de sécurité sur votre carte bancaire, généralement composé de trois chiffres. Visa emploie le terme CVV (Card Verification Value), tandis que Mastercard utilise CVC (Card Verification Code), mais les deux désignent une fonction équivalente. Ce code sert essentiellement à vérifier, lors d’un achat à distance, que vous avez bien accès à votre carte, en complément de son numéro et de sa date d’expiration. C’est pourquoi vous ne devez pas le communiquer à n’importe qui.
Dans ses notes de mises à jour de ses services, Google a indiqué un nouveau changement ce 23 novembre pour la version 26.46 de services Google Play sur Android. L’entreprise explique que vous pouvez désormais « saisir automatiquement les codes de sécurité (CVV/code CVC) enregistrés sur les écrans de validation des cartes dans Google Wallet après vous être authentifié avec le déverrouillage de l’écran de votre appareil. » Ainsi, lorsque vous payez en ligne, Google Wallet peut suggérer votre code à rentrer automatiquement.

articles.title: AMD and Winbond vulnerabilities let attackers brute-force BitLocker PINs on millions of PCs — cracking a six-digit PIN drops from 19 years to 20 days
articles.summary:
AMD and Winbond vulnerabilities let attackers brute-force BitLocker PINs on millions of PCs — cracking a six-digit PIN drops from 19 years to 20 days
Machines using Winbond-based SPI flash not fixable without new hardware, while vulnerable AMD PCs likely need new BIOS files.
Former owners of laptops gained yet another concern today. Firmware-backed drive encryption setups like Windows' BitLocker are meant to protect against someone stealing your laptop or desktop computer. Prospective thieves would have a hard time guessing your PIN, as they'll eventually have to wait 10 minutes for each attempt. That is, unless your machine uses a modern AMD CPU or relies on Winbond's SPI flash — in which case your data may be open for inspection in a few days, or even hours, as researchers from Technische Universität Berlin found out.
The paper covers many vulnerabilities, but we'll focus on the big three. All focus on having a way to brute-force an encrypted drive's password in a matter of days/hours rather than years. Physical access is required for the attacks, but hardware theft is precisely the scenario that disk encryption is meant to protect against.
An attacker makes brute-forcing easier by resetting, or pretending to increase, the counter that records the number of failed unlock attempts. On Intel- and AMD-based PCs using the fTPM for security — nearly all modern x86 consumer machines — this counter is stored encrypted in an SPI flash chip on the motherboard.

Waymo a longtemps préféré contourner les autoroutes, quitte à rallonger les trajets de ses clients, qui ne manquaient d’ailleurs pas de s’en plaindre. La filiale d’Alphabet ne s’y est lancée que fin 2025 en connaissant la difficulté de l’exercice, « très facile à apprendre, mais très difficile à maîtriser « selon son co-P.-D.G, Dmitri Dolgov.

Après des intrusions dans des chantiers en Arizona et en Californie, l’entreprise, qui prépare doucement son lancement en Europe, a suspendu ces trajets spécifiques et rappelé près de 3 900 véhicules en juin. Elle n’a ensuite repris l’autoroute que progressivement, fin juillet, avec un logiciel mis à jour. Mais les difficultés s’enchaînent.

articles.title: En Madrid la crisis de la vivienda se está cobrando una nueva víctima: 370.000 metros cuadrados de oficinas

En Madrid cada vez más propietarios de oficinas están convencidos de tener un tesoro. Y no porque se imaginen a grandes multinacionales de inquilinas. Sus planes están lejos del ámbito empresarial y corporativo y apuntan a un sector mucho más rentable: el residencial. Desde 2023, coincidiendo con la escalada del precio de la vivienda, Madrid ha visto cómo 374.100 m2 que en su día se destinaron a oficinas se reenfocaban a nuevos usos, como alojamiento turístico, trasteros o (sobre todo) nuevos apartamentos.
Hay quien habla ya de una auténtica reconversión.

Aunque su encarecimiento se ha ido moderando, los gráficos de Idealista muestran que el m2 cuesta hoy en la capital 6.400 euros, muy por encima de los 3.700 de 2020. El repunte ha sido claro también en el mercado del alquiler, donde durante el mismo período el m2 se elevó un 52% y se sitúa en máximos históricos, al menos si hablamos de valor nominal (otra cosa es el real).
Al mercado de las oficinas tampoco parece irle mal. El informe trimestral de MVGM muestra que en el último año los alquileres se encarecieron un 9,7% en Madrid: en el centro de la ciudad se paga una renta media de 27,6 €/m2 y en el distrito más cotizado se alcanzan los 43,4. articles.title: PCB Grounding Design and Return Path
articles.summary:
Many PCB design guidelines reduce grounding to a few rules:
- Separate analog and digital ground
- Connect power ground and signal ground at a single point
- Cut out copper under switching nodes
These rules are not wrong, but they are incomplete. They do not answer a fundamental question: where does the current return?
If a ground plane is split and a signal crosses the gap, its return current may be forced to detour. The result can be higher electromagnetic radiation, even though the original intention was noise isolation. This article follows one main principle: design “ground” as a return path.
Why Ground Moves
Every copper trace, via, and ground plane has impedance.
At DC, copper resistance causes a voltage drop. When current changes rapidly, parasitic inductance also produces a voltage.
If a sensitive measurement branch shares part of its return path with a high-current branch, the voltage drop across that shared copper appears in the measurement branch.
The “ground” may then move with the high-current load. This is common-impedance coupling.
As shown above, loads farther along a shared return copper path use more common copper segments and may see larger ground-potential shifts. In a real PCB, current distribution and impedance vary with frequency, copper shape, and via structure; a single DC resistance cannot represent the return path. De acuerdo con el portal de Binance, la moneda digital solana actualmente cuenta con 122.3M de unidades creadas.

articles.title: Ontario man accidentally records himself stealing Ray-Ban Meta Glasses
articles.summary:
Ontario police are searching for a man who accidentally recorded himself stealing a pair of Meta Ray-Ban Glasses.
On Thursday, South Simcoe Police took to social media to ask the public to identify a male suspect in a Cookstown eyewear store robbery on Nov. 11. According to police, the man brought a counterfeit pair of glasses to swap out with a genuine pair of Meta Ray-Bans. Once staff discovered the switch, they reviewed a device that had previously been paired with the smart glasses and found that the suspect had inadvertently recorded video of himself during the theft using the in-frame camera.
South Simcoe Police has since shared the video on its social media channels to see if members of the public can help identify the suspect. The organization is asking those with tips to contact either 705-436-2141 or 905-775-3311 with the reference occurrence number PW26000297.
All in all, it’s a pretty funny revelation in an otherwise serious situation. In general, there’s been a lot of valid privacy concerns related to Ray-Ban Meta Glasses for how they allow people to record others, especially women, without consent. This has led them to be dubbed “pervert glasses” by many. So, to see this thief inadvertently use the glasses for good — to catch himself in the act — is an absolute riot.

Le parquet a refusé d’engager des poursuites pénales et renvoie le dossier au civil, sans autre suite à ce stade.
Une parade connue depuis San Francisco

La méthode a un précédent daté : à l’été 2023, les militants du collectif Safe Street Rebel, à San Francisco, neutralisaient déjà les Waymo d’un simple cône posé sur le capot. Le suspect de Denver ajoute les œufs : chaque voiture maculée repart en nettoyage, environ 2 000 dollars la séance, sans dégât permanent constaté. Le même rapport évoque un homme quittant les lieux au volant d’une Corolla grise.
La mairie, elle, défend son expérience : le maire vante des robotaxis « populaires et abordables ». L’entreprise revendique de son côté des centaines de milliers de courses par semaine à l’échelle des États-Unis, et Denver compte parmi ses terrains les plus récents. Depuis la mi-novembre, le régulateur californien lui interdit par ailleurs les autoroutes de l’État, et Waymo a suspendu ce type de trajets dans tout le pays.

articles.title: Intel faced a choice: Give Trump 10% or face the consequences

The message from the Trump administration to one of the world’s leading semiconductor companies was clear: Give the US government a chunk of your company. Right now. Or else.
Do not make the “mistake of thinking that this is a negotiation,” Commerce Department lawyer David Shapiro told the chief financial officer of the Intel Corporation in August 2025, according to internal notes from a company call contained in a federal lawsuit. “The President is expecting to announce a deal on these terms on Friday.”
Shapiro acknowledged that “the Board could choose not to accept the offer,” according to a summary of his remarks prepared for Intel’s directors. But the Trump administration official “noted that rejection will have consequences that [Shapiro] cannot predict.”
Days later, the board gave the administration what it wanted. “It is my Great Honor to report that the United States of America now fully owns and controls 10% of INTEL,” Donald Trump posted to his social platform. “The United States paid nothing for these Shares, and the Shares are now valued at approximately $11 Billion Dollars. This is a great Deal for America.”
President Trump was similarly jubilant on Monday, announcing that he had “convinced” Nvidia’s board of directors to rehire chief executive Jensen Huang. The proclamation was a shock. But it wasn’t entirely without precedent.

A principal pressão vem das memórias. Fornecedores têm direcionado capacidade para aplicações de inteligência artificial e servidores, que disputam recursos de produção com os componentes destinados aos celulares. A oferta restrita encarece os aparelhos e torna mais difícil vender celulares de entrada com lucro.
Em estudo publicado em novembro, a Counterpoint calculou que a memória passou a representar 54% do custo dos componentes de um smartphone básico, contra 20% no terceiro trimestre de 2025. Esse percentual vale para a fabricação, antes das despesas e margens do varejo.
Para lidar com o encarecimento, fabricantes aumentam os preços e concentram recursos em menos modelos e mercados prioritários. Os aparelhos premium têm resistido melhor, embora não compensem as perdas nos segmentos populares.

Ken Kutaragi, reconocido como uno de los principales responsables de la creación de PlayStation, considera que las consolas tradicionales podrían dejar de ser necesarias en el futuro. El exdirectivo de Sony sostiene que el encarecimiento del hardware, la evolución de la inteligencia artificial y los cambios en la forma de procesar los videojuegos podrían transformar por completo la industria.
Durante sus declaraciones para The Game Business, Kutaragi planteó la posibilidad de que los jugadores ya no necesiten comprar dispositivos especializados para disfrutar de sus títulos favoritos. “Quizá llegue un momento en que no necesitemos consolas en absoluto. Es un peligro real”, señaló al reflexionar sobre el futuro de estos equipos.
Su pronóstico llega en un momento en que los fabricantes enfrentan mayores costos para desarrollar nuevas generaciones de hardware. PlayStation, Xbox y las computadoras destinadas a videojuegos dependen de componentes cada vez más avanzados, cuyo precio también está condicionado por la creciente demanda de infraestructura para inteligencia artificial.
Por qué el creador de PlayStation cree que las consolas podrían desaparecer
Uno de los principales argumentos de Kutaragi está relacionado con el precio del hardware. Actualmente, fabricar una computadora o una consola capaz de ejecutar videojuegos exigentes requiere procesadores, tarjetas gráficas y memorias de alto rendimiento.

articles.title: The no-buy challenge: How to stop unnecessary spending
articles.summary:
The no-buy challenge: How to stop unnecessary spending
Learn how to try a no-buy challenge, identify spending triggers and build healthier money habits without feeling deprived.
Have you ever ordered something online because it was on sale, bought clothes you barely wore or added products to your cart simply because they looked appealing? These small purchases may not seem significant individually, but over time, they can take up a considerable part of your monthly budget.
The no-buy challenge is a simple way to break this cycle. Instead of constantly looking for ways to earn more money, it encourages you to examine your spending habits and become more intentional about what you buy.
The idea is not to stop enjoying life or avoid every purchase. It is to take a temporary break from unnecessary shopping, understand your spending triggers and make room for financial priorities.
What is the no-buy challenge?
A no-buy challenge is a personal commitment to stop purchasing non-essential items for a fixed period. This could be seven days, 30 days, three months or even an entire year.
During this period, you continue paying for necessities such as rent, groceries, bills, healthcare and transportation. However, you put selected purchases on hold, including unnecessary clothes, beauty products, gadgets, home decor and impulse online orders.
The rules depend on your lifestyle and financial goals. Some people choose to avoid shopping altogether, while others focus on specific categories …

articles.title: Japón ha encontrado una segunda vida para sus trenes bala retirados: convertir su aluminio en ventanas de edificios
articles.summary:
Si pensamos en las grandes señas de identidad tecnológica de Japón, seguramente los trenes bala ocupen un lugar destacado. Desde que el Shinkansen comenzó a funcionar en 1964, estos trenes se han convertido en un símbolo de la capacidad del país para desarrollar sistemas de transporte rápidos, precisos y fiables. Estamos acostumbrados a hablar de sus velocidades, de su puntualidad y de las innovaciones que incorporan las nuevas generaciones. Sin embargo, hay una parte de su historia a la que solemos prestar mucha menos atención: qué sucede cuando llega el momento de retirarlos.
Una de las respuestas nos llega de la mano de JR Central, la compañía que opera el Shinkansen de Tokaido, la línea de alta velocidad que conecta Tokio con Nagoya y Osaka. El pasado 20 de noviembre, el operador ferroviario anunció que, junto a su filial comercial JR Tokai Corporation y al fabricante de materiales de construcción LIXIL, ha establecido un sistema para recuperar el aluminio de los vehículos retirados e incorporarlo a la gama PremiAL. Se trata de un material con contenido reciclado que tendrá entre sus aplicaciones la fabricación de marcos de ventanas para edificios.
La primera aplicación de esta colaboración ya tiene nombre y ubicación. Se trata de Proud Meito Issha Garden, una promoción residencial de 46 viviendas que Nomura Real Estate y Toho Gas Real Estate Development están desarrollando en Nagoya, cuya finalización está prevista para finales de octubre de 2027. articles.title: Sur deux roues et sans moteur thermique : l’incroyable exploit de ce SUV BYD face à un Boeing 747
articles.summary:
En 2006, Volkswagen avait bluffé le monde en tractant un Boeing 747 avec son Touareg. Équipé du très musculeux V10 TDI, le SUV allemand est parvenu à promener le gros porteur de 155 tonnes sur près de 150 mètres à faible vitesse. Monumental à l’époque, le coup de pub demeure encore remarquable aujourd’hui. BYD reproduit ainsi l’exploit avec sa marque Denza désireuse de se faire une place dans le premium automobile.
Son SUV Bao 5 s’est ainsi mis à la tâche dans des conditions presque similaires. Puisque reproduire la même chose n’aurait aucun sens, BYD a tenu à corser les choses avec un Boeing 747-400 plus imposant que le 747-200 utilisé par Volkswagen. La masse de l’engin passe ainsi de 155 à 180 tonnes, ce qui n’est pas rien. Ensuite, le Denza Bao 5 s’est vu imposer un handicap de taille en roulant uniquement sur deux roues !
Deux roues retirées et 1 600 m parcourus : les coulisses d’une image surréaliste
Pour montrer qu’il n’y a pas de triche, BYD a carrément retiré les deux roues du côté droit pour des images surréalistes. Le but était de démontrer les capacités de l’ensemble hybride rechargeable du SUV. Pour accommoder le véhicule, trois essais ont été successivement menés avec une difficulté allant crescendo : le premier sur quatre roues, le deuxième sur trois roues et le troisième sur deux roues.
Au final, le Bao 5 a tracté le Boeing sur près de 1 600 mètres, ce qui surpasse largement la performance établie il y a 20 ans par Volkswagen. Quelques modifications ont néanmo…

articles.title: Cómo bloquear WhatsApp con contraseña
articles.summary:
Bloquear la aplicación de WhatsApp con contraseña agrega una capa de seguridad para proteger el acceso a la plataforma tanto en teléfonos Android como en iPhone.
En Android, el bloqueo de aplicación permite usar la huella dactilar o el reconocimiento facial para desbloquear WhatsApp. Aunque la aplicación permanezca bloqueada, es posible atender llamadas.
Para utilizar esta función, primero es necesario configurar los rasgos biométricos, como la huella dactilar o el reconocimiento facial, en los ajustes del teléfono.
Cómo activar el bloqueo de WhatsApp en Android
En WhatsApp, toca el ícono de más opciones, representado por tres puntos verticales, y sigue esta ruta: Ajustes > Privacidad > Bloqueo de aplicación. Luego, activa la opción “Desbloquear con rasgos biométricos”.
Escanea el rostro para confirmar la configuración. Es posible elegir cuánto tiempo debe transcurrir antes de que la aplicación solicite nuevamente la autenticación y activar la opción “Mostrar contenido en las notificaciones” para ver una vista previa de los mensajes nuevos.
Para desactivar el bloqueo, toca el ícono de más opciones y ve a Ajustes > Privacidad > Bloqueo de aplicación. Después, desactiva “Desbloquear con rasgos biométricos”.
La función está disponible en dispositivos con Android 6.0 o superior que tengan sensor de huella dactilar y sean compatibles con la API de huella dactilar de Google. El reconocimiento facial solo funciona en equipos que cuenten con un escáner para ese fin.

No HC relief to Tata Trusts on plea against Chandrasekaran reappointment; Nov 30 board meet on
A bench of Justice Abhay Ahuja said any outcome of the meeting shall be subject to final orders of the court.
Declining any urgent relief to the two Tata Trusts that had challenged the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for a third five-year term, the Bombay High Court on Friday said the November 30 board meeting of Tata Sons can be held as scheduled.
A bench of Justice Abhay Ahuja said any outcome of the meeting shall be subject to final orders of the court.
The Tata Trusts had sought for the meeting to be deferred or stayed or for an order that Chandrasekaran would not be allowed to exercise his vote as executive chairman.
During the hearing, the court asked what was the need to defer the meeting or not permit Chandrasekaran to cast his vote as executive chairman when he is already holding the post in his second term.
The court, however, refused to grant any relief to the two Tata Trusts on Friday.
"We are not granting any relief today. Let the meeting (on November 30) go on as per schedule. Any outcome of the meeting would be subject to our final orders," the court said.
The bench ordered Tata Sons and the other respondents in the case, which include the board members, to submit their reply affidavits to two suits filed on Thursday (November 26) and posted the matter for further hearing on January 18, 2027.

While the immediate dispute centers on ASML and immersion deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography, the legislation raises a broader question: How much of China’s manufacturing capability depends on foreign equipment that measures and controls production rather than creates semiconductor structures?
As transistor architectures and advanced packaging become more complex, the answer increasingly lies in metrology and inspection.
The economics of yield
Gate-all-around (GAA) transistors require precise control of nanosheet dimensions, epitaxial layer thickness, and material composition. Small variations can affect threshold voltage, carrier mobility, and device performance. Advanced packaging introduces additional challenges, particularly in surface preparation, bonding alignment, and interconnect integrity.
Consider a simplified assembly containing eight known-good dies and requiring seven bonding operations. Assuming independent bonding outcomes, a 99% yield per operation produces a cumulative bonding yield of approximately 93%. articles.title: GTA 6 Exposes the Console Hardware Crisis- EE Times
articles.summary:
GTA 6 is the biggest launch in entertainment history. But the consoles it runs on were designed around assumptions about silicon economics that no longer hold.
What’s under the hood?
On Nov. 19, after more than a decade of waiting and several delays, Rockstar released Grand Theft Auto VI, or GTA 6. According to Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar’s parent company, the game sold 32.5 million copies before release and generated $3.79 billion in revenue on its first day, which is probably the biggest entertainment launch in history.
While most of the coverage has been about the game, I find the hardware underneath it a more interesting story: GTA 6 runs only on the PlayStation 5 and the Xbox Series X|S, consoles whose silicon was defined around 2019 and which launched in 2020. A console is a long bet on silicon economics, placed years before the first unit ships and, for reasons we’ll explain below, expected to hold for about seven years. In this generation, it seems to me that each of the key assumptions behind that bet has failed, and GTA 6 is the moment when tens of millions of buyers feel it, both at the checkout and on the screen.
The three assumptions are that hardware gets cheaper as a generation matures, that memory is a commodity, and that a frozen platform can carry a generation for seven years.
Hardware was supposed to get cheaper

Les règles de conception sont 3,6 fois plus nombreuses sur l’A14 que sur les procédés N5 et N4P, de la famille du 5 nm, selon les chiffres de TSMC relevés par Tom’s Hardware US. Es lo que han conseguido desde el Instituto de Ingeniería Termofísica (IET) de la Academia China de Ciencias (CAS), junto a Zhongchu Guoneng (Beijing) Technology Co.: ambas entidades acaban de dar por completadas las pruebas de un expansor de 600 MW. Una batería “de aire”. Esta tecnología utiliza el exceso de energía que se produce durante los periodos de baja demanda eléctrica para comprimir aire a través de un compresor y almacenarlo. Cuando esa misma demanda crece y hace falta más electricidad, el aire comprimido se libera para accionar un expansor que, mediante trabajo mecánico, acciona un generador que produce electricidad.
De este modo, el funcionamiento es parecido al de una batería convencional y recargable, solo que en este caso es gigante y cuyo medio de almacenamiento es por aire en lugar de componentes electroquímicos. The printed circuit boards (PCBs) connecting chips, memory, and networking equipment are becoming harder to manufacture, and Chinese companies are racing to supply the materials and equipment they require.

Having a plentiful and regular supply of those components in the manufacturing process is important because the tiny drill bit used to make the circuit boards inside AI servers could be worn out after drilling fewer than 200 holes, according to HSBC, compared with around 2,000 holes for older materials.

El estudio calculó que, bajo escenarios de altas emisiones y marejadas, el 5,1 % de la superficie de Los Santos quedaría bajo el agua hacia 2300.
Esta estimación se refiere específicamente al mapa del videojuego, aunque permite explorar de qué manera herramientas similares podrían contribuir al análisis de riesgos de inundación en entornos urbanos reales.
Según los autores, se trata del primer análisis cuantitativo sobre impacto climático elaborado a partir de datos topográficos extraídos de un videojuego comercial. El trabajo surgió como parte de una tesis de maestría.
Los investigadores aprovecharon que Los Santos recrea de forma ficticia a Los Ángeles para comparar el modelo de terreno del juego con estudios científicos sobre la vulnerabilidad de la ciudad real.
Concluyeron que el mapa posee un nivel de detalle geográfico suficiente para reproducir patrones de inundación similares, lo que sugiere que los entornos virtuales podrían utilizarse como herramientas complementarias para estudiar y comunicar posibles efectos del cambio climático en ciudades reales.

La influencia social se articula a través de mecanismos diversos y constituye la base, entre otras cosas, de nuestra capacidad para construir sociedades complejas. También está detrás de todas las acciones comerciales y de marketing que nos bombardean diariamente.

Hackers reportedly breach key US Air Force cloud platform
Hackers have reportedly breached Cloud One, a platform that the U.S. Air Force uses to power dozens of internal applications.
Reuters broke the news today, citing three people familiar with the matter. The news agency reported that the cyberattack could “jeopardize a vast swath” of sensitive data.
Cloud One runs on infrastructure from Amazon.com Inc., Microsoft Corp., Oracle Corp. and Google LLC. The applications that it powers perform a wide range of tasks. Some are designed to ease administrative chores such as managing personnel records, while others analyze radar data and track the location of hardware assets.
The breach was reportedly discovered “within the past month or so.” Technical personnel spotted malicious activity while performing a system upgrade. According to Reuters, the investigators probing the incident have asked the U.S. Cyber Command to assist with the analysis.
Many key details about the cyberattack, including when it started, remain unclear. However, today’s report did specify that the breach saw hackers gain access to Cloud One’s control plane.
A control plane is a software engine that coordinates a technology system’s other components. Its role varies based on the system that it powers. The Kubernetes control plane, for example, performs tasks such as spinning up containers, while a network’s control plane coordinates the flow of traffic.

articles.title: Piden retomar el plan para devolver el lince boreal a los Pirineos. El problema es si es buena idea reintroducir esta especie
articles.summary:
Es uno de nuestros relatos heroicos: en 2002 quedaban menos de cien linces ibéricos en libertad y el verano pasado el censo ibérico ya iba por 2.663 ejemplares, con 542 hembras reproductoras y 952 crías. Esta es una de las mayores historias de éxito de la conservación europea. Pero la Península no tuvo un único lince, sino dos. El otro, más grande, más montañero y con otro tipo de dieta, nunca volvió. Hablamos del lince boreal, el que ahora se plantea: ¿merece la pena traerlo de vuelta?
El primo del norte. El lince boreal (Lynx lynx) pesa entre 18 y 30 kilos, frente a los 12-15 del ibérico. Y en lugar de conejos caza corzos y ciervos. En España está oficialmente extinguido: es una de las 13 especies del listado de extinguidas. Un esqueleto de la Sima Topinoria, en Cantabria, lo sitúa hace unos 210 años en la Cordillera Cantábrica. En los Pirineos, el último documento histórico es de 1930. En Europa, en cambio, sigue vivo, y donde se reintrodujo funcionó: en los años 70, en Suiza ha pasado de unos 30 linces de los Cárpatos a los 360 de la actualidad.
Lo que piden. Nadie va a soltar un lince mañana. En octubre de 2025, Amics del Parc Natural de l’Alt Pirineu y ADLO Pirineu plantearon un programa piloto con machos castrados traídos de Rumanía. El 13 de octubre de 2026 se sumaron SEO/BirdLife, Depana, Ecologistes en Acció y ADDA para pedir a la Generalitat que recupere y actualice un plan de viabilidad anunciado en 2016. Segundo a Reuters, o país ainda não identificou os responsáveis, o alcance do acesso e nem se (ou quais) informações foram roubadas. O incidente, que atinge uma peça central da infraestrutura de TI da Força Aérea estadunidense, teria sido descoberto no último mês durante trabalhos de atualização da plataforma.
A Cloud One foi criada em 2017 para concentrar parte das necessidades de computação em nuvem da Força Aérea dos Estados Unidos, reunindo serviços de empresas como Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet (dona do Google) e Oracle.
A invasão da Cloud One é mais um incidente em uma sequência recente envolvendo órgãos do governo do país. Ao menos seis outros casos vieram a público recentemente, segundo a Reuters, incluindo ataques ao Pentágono e um vazamento de informações de funcionários do Departamento de Segurança Interna.
Até então, o Cloud One mantinha uma postura de alta taxa de sucesso contra ataques cibernéticos. Em 2023, seus líderes afirmavam que “não há espaço para erros quando se trata de segurança”.

La Wallonie fait de la résistance ! Le géant de Mountain View construit ce data center sur un ancien site minier d'une cinquantaine d'hectares, à cheval sur les communes de Farciennes, Aiseau-Presles et Sambreville. La Wallonie lui avait accordé un permis en 2024, avec des serveurs refroidis par air. Google a ensuite demandé à agrandir la surface construite et à refroidir ses machines avec l'eau de la Sambre, la tristement célèbre rivière qui longe le site. Après le recours d'un habitant, François Desquesnes (Les Engagés), ministre wallon de l'Aménagement du territoire, a refusé cette modification en août. Google a contesté ce refus devant le Conseil d'État, et il a continué à bâtir en attendant l'audience.

Varios clientes afirmaron que recibieron la alerta aunque tenían activada la verificación en dos pasos (un segundo código además de la contraseña).
Algunos, al revisar su cuenta, no encontraron ningún dispositivo extraño en la lista. Otros recibieron el aviso sin haber usado nunca el gestor, entre ellos una persona que había pedido borrar su cuenta de almacenamiento casi un año antes.
Qué explicó pCloud sobre el ciberataque
La empresa respondió mediante un comunicado en el que señala que “se produjo un ciberataque dirigido a pCloud Pass, que fue contenido con prontitud por el equipo de pCloud”. articles.title: Qué significa el emoji del mate y cómo hacer sticker del termo y mate

El emoji del mate es uno de los íconos culturales más reconocibles en las plataformas de mensajería como WhatsApp. Aunque visualmente representa la tradicional calabaza con yerba y bombilla, su uso en las conversaciones digitales abarca significados que exceden la infusión misma.
Qué significa el emoji del mate en la comunicación digital
Más allá de su referencia literal a la bebida tradicional del Cono Sur, el emoji del mate opera como un símbolo de identidad, hospitalidad y encuentro social. En países como Argentina y Uruguay, suele utilizarse para invitar a una reunión, señalar una pausa en la jornada laboral o expresar cercanía con el interlocutor.
Con su adopción internacional, el ícono adquirió nuevas capas de significado fuera de Sudamérica. En distintas culturas, los usuarios lo emplean para comunicar calidez, momentos de descanso, conexión cotidiana y conversaciones vinculadas con hábitos saludables y bienestar.
El origen del ícono y su aprobación en Unicode
La llegada del mate a los teclados digitales fue resultado de una campaña impulsada desde Argentina en 2015 por la firma yerbatera CBSé bajo la consigna #UnEmojiParaElMate. La iniciativa incluyó acciones en redes sociales, eventos y una recolección de firmas en la plataforma Change.org, culminando con la presentación formal de una propuesta técnica ante el Consorcio Unicode, el organismo estadounidense encargado de estandarizar y aprobar los emojis a nivel global.

articles.title: Detectan en Linux un fallo de seguridad de 12 años que podría dar acceso privilegiado a los hackers
articles.summary:
Un fallo de seguridad crítico que lleva 12 años oculto en el kernel de Linux permite a los atacantes obtener acceso remoto con privilegios de administrador en los dispositivos afectados, según advirtieron investigadores de ciberseguridad. La vulnerabilidad, bautizada NFS2ROOT, recibió una puntuación de gravedad de 9,8 sobre 10 y afecta al servidor de red NFS (Network File System) integrado en el núcleo del sistema operativo.
El origen de un fallo que se remonta a 2014
La falla, catalogada como CVE-2026-99362, corresponde a un desbordamiento de búfer en la memoria dinámica (heap buffer overflow) dentro del servidor NFS del kernel (nfsd). Fue introducida por primera vez con la versión 3.16 del kernel de Linux, lanzada en marzo de 2014, lo que implica que permaneció sin detectar durante más de una década.
El problema afecta a todas las versiones anteriores a la 6.12.117, 6.18.61, 7.3.2 o 7.4-rc1, siempre que el servicio nfsd (en sus versiones 4.1 o 4.2) esté cargado y en ejecución. Además, el sistema debe tener accesible desde internet el puerto TCP 2049, condición habitual en servidores de archivos, dispositivos de almacenamiento conectado en red (NAS), granjas de compilación y nodos de almacenamiento de Kubernetes.
El investigador Jérémy Jean, de la agencia francesa ANSSI, descubrió la vulnerabilidad y presentó una solución en agosto de 2026. Meses después, a fines de septiembre, los investigadores de la firma OpenSec compartieron con los responsables del mantenimiento de nfsd…

articles.title: Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
articles.summary:
Details have emerged about a new zero-day vulnerability in Cacti, an open-source network monitoring tool, that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution.
The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, which has yet to be assigned a CVE identifier, has been tracked as 4HTTP2SHELL and 4HTTP2ROOT.
"I found a path from a fresh, unauthenticated HTTP session to command execution as the Cacti server user in four requests," a security researcher who goes by the online alias "ek0ms savi0r" said. "No login. No valid API key. No phishing. Just four HTTP requests against the default guest surface."
The shortcoming affects Cacti Core 1.2.31, the latest version, when the guest account is enabled. It's worth noting that the guest account is disabled by default starting with Cacti version 0.8.7.
At a high level, the vulnerability allows an attacker to abuse the guest access to write an unvalidated value (i.e., non-numeric text) into a setting called "preview_graphs_per_page" via "auth_profile.php?action=update_data." The configuration parameter controls how many graphs are displayed per page when viewing graphs in Preview Mode.
The crafted value takes the form of arbitrary SQL strings that can be turned into a second-order SQL injection by taking advantage of the fact that Cacti does not validate that the user-provided input is actually an integer value. This, in turn, opens the door for arbitrary SQL query execution when the graph preview page ("graph_view.php") is loaded with default filter…

O MCP (Model Context Protocol) é um protocolo aberto criado pela Anthropic para conectar assistentes e modelos de IA a arquivos, bancos de dados e APIs de forma padronizada. Em vez de criar integrações do zero para cada fonte, ele oferece uma linguagem comum para buscar contexto e executar ações em tempo real.
Aplicar o MCP em inteligência artificial é essencial porque tira os modelos do isolamento e amplia a precisão das respostas com dados atualizados. Isso destrava automações úteis no dia a dia, permitindo que agentes consultem sistemas externos e operem ferramentas com mais confiabilidade.
A seguir, o Tecnoblog te explica detalhadamente o que é o protocolo MCP e suas aplicações.
O Model Context Protocol (MCP) é um protocolo aberto lançado pela Anthropic em novembro de 2024, atuando como uma camada universal de “plug-ins” para ferramentas de inteligência artificial. articles.title: How to Keep Your Security Picture Current When Attackers Move at AI Speed
articles.summary:
Most security metrics are not built to be used. They are built to be shown. Somewhere between the quarterly review and the next status update, a set of numbers gets assembled that looks reassuring in a room and tells almost no one what is actually happening across the environment that week. Someone pulls them together the week before, cleans them up, and presents a picture of a program that is, as of that one morning, fine.
This is not a failure of effort. Security teams are doing the work, often times more of it than anyone outside the team realizes. The problem is that the reporting cycle rewards the snapshot, and a snapshot is a memory, not a measurement. It tells you how things looked on the day you looked. It says very little about the weeks in between, and risk does not keep to a reporting schedule.
Gathering the Picture Is the Hard Part, and It Is Getting Harder
The conversation about security metrics usually jumps straight to which numbers matter. That skips the part that actually hurts. Before anyone can report a single metric, someone has to go and gather it, and today that is a genuinely painful job.
The information needed to describe a security posture is scattered across dozens of systems that were never meant to talk to each other. Cloud accounts, identity providers, endpoints, code repositories, ticketing tools, each one holds a piece. Pulling those pieces together usually means logging into one console after another, exporting spreadsheets, taking screenshots,…

Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a cyber attack in which a threat actor leveraged a Microsoft Store application to deliver a remote access trojan (RAT) called Vinci RAT.
The intrusion, according to eSentire, begins with a redirection to a bogus site for a sniping tool ("snipp.codes-team[.]com"), from where a Microsoft-signed installer called "Snipping-Tool.exe" is downloaded. Executing the binary leads to the installation of Setup Assistant, an Electron-based application published on the Microsoft Store by ETPS Ltd.
"The application was heavily obfuscated, maintained communication with C2 [command-and-control] infrastructure, monitored the victim's Downloads folder, and supported execution of C2-supplied PowerShell and JavaScript," eSentire said.
"This access was used to launch a malicious PowerShell stager, establish persistence through a scheduled task, and retrieve a previously undocumented PowerShell-based RAT."
Once installed, Setup Assistant acts as a backdoor and is designed to run obfuscated JavaScript that allows it to contact the C2 server at "setup-assistant[.]com" and retrieve arbitrary PowerShell or JavaScript code, ultimately resulting in the deployment of the RAT by means of a stager.
Vinci RAT, as the malware is called, is equipped to fingerprint the host, enumerate installed security tools, facilitate remote and reverse shell access, deliver files, and execute shellcode, DLL, EXE, and PowerShell payloads.

articles.title: pCloud Password Manager Hit by Cyber Attack Involving Email Address Exposure and Login Attempts
articles.summary:
Cross-platform password manager pCloud Pass has confirmed it was targeted by a cyber attack after users reported seeing unknown devices being connected to their accounts.
"A cyber attack targeting pCloud Pass occurred, which was promptly contained by the pCloud team," the Swiss company said in response to a number of posts on Reddit. "Unfortunately, a small number of pCloud Pass user email addresses were exposed and login attempts were made. Our system sends a notification automatically to each of these addresses."
pCloud emphasized that user data was not compromised in the attack, adding passwords, notes, and other information stored in pCloud Pass are encrypted and can only be accessed after providing a Master Password.
It also said the incident was limited to pCloud Pass, and that pCloud Cloud Storage services are not affected.
"With the advancement of AI, vulnerabilities in the software that every online service relies upon (such as operating systems, programming languages, and libraries) are being discovered faster than ever - sometimes even before the developers themselves identify them and release a fix," the pCloud Team said.
pCloud has also urged users to stay alert for phishing attacks that may trick recipients into entering their Master Password or recovery words by email, phone, or chat.

articles.title: Científico cree casi seguro que laboratorios de IA guardan hallazgos que afectarían el cifrado de internet
articles.summary:
El científico de la computación Scott Aaronson, profesor de la Universidad de Texas en Austin, escribió en su blog que está “virtualmente seguro” de que los laboratorios de IA tienen resultados que romperían parte de la criptografía actual. Aclaró que no conoce cuáles son ni si implican un riesgo inmediato.
La criptografía es el conjunto de técnicas matemáticas que protege contraseñas, pagos y mensajes en internet. El sistema RSA, uno de los más usados, se apoya en que factorizar números enormes —descomponerlos en sus factores primos— es inviable para las computadoras actuales.
Aaronson publicó el 25 de noviembre una entrada sobre las pruebas matemáticas que OpenAI y Anthropic habían difundido esa semana. Al final, escribió que algunos de esos avances aportarán algoritmos que romperán sistemas de cifrado hoy en uso y que tiene “múltiples fuentes confiables” de que los laboratorios guardan “una o más bombas” en ese terreno.
El mismo texto marca los límites: hasta que vea detalles o hable con alguien de un laboratorio, dijo, tiene mucha menos confianza sobre la naturaleza concreta de esos hallazgos. Escribió que no quiere difundir rumores sin confirmar y que lo dicho podría haberse deformado al pasar de boca en boca.
El martes 24 de noviembre, Aaronson había comentado en su blog que oyó “muchos, muchos rumores” de que uno de los laboratorios, o ambos, tenía un método rápido para factorizar números grandes, lo que rompería RSA. Ese comentario circuló en la red social X, según in…

Le groupe Lumibird est né en 2017 de la fusion de Keopsys, installé à Lannion, et de Quantel. Dans la ville, siège et berceau de l'entreprise, le projet de Thales a surpris les milieux économiques. Pour l'une des personnes interrogées par Ouest-France, il s'agit d'« une reconnaissance de l'expertise acquise ici ». Le P.-D.G, Marc Le Flohic, contrôle la majorité du capital par l'intermédiaire de deux sociétés, et c'est à elles que Thales achètera ce bloc d'actions, selon le communiqué des deux groupes. Avant cette opération, Lumibird doit céder sa division médicale, spécialisée dans l'ophtalmologie, à l'américain IPG Photonics. Les deux sociétés ont signé cette vente en septembre, pour 300 millions d'euros. Thales reprendra donc la seule branche photonique de Lumibird, l'un de ses fournisseurs de télémètres laser.

Avec plus de 600 salariés, la branche photonique de Lumibird a réalisé 113,4 millions d'euros de ventes en 2025.
